item.title: Chorizo Smash Breakfast Tacos
item.description:
Ingredients

  • Chorizo - 300g
  • Small tortillas - 6
  • Eggs - 3
  • Cheddar cheese - 1 cup (shredded)
  • Bacon - 3–4 rashers (optional)
  • Onion - 1 (caramelised)

Sauce (optional)

  • Mayonnaise
  • Hot sauce
  • Mustard or similar tangy sauce

Directions

  1. Press chorizo directly onto tortillas in a thin layer
  2. Cook meat-side down in a hot pan until crispy
  3. Flip tortillas and crack egg on top (or cook eggs separately)
  4. Add cheese and allow to melt
  5. Top with bacon and caramelised onion
  6. Fold and serve hot

Macros

  • Calories - 620
  • Protein - 32g
  • Carbs - 38g
  • Fat - 38g

Notes

  • Confirmed from indexed reel description :contentReference[oaicite:2]{index=2}
  • “Smash taco” method = meat pressed into tortilla and cooked together
  • Breakfast-focused variation of viral smash taco trend

item.title: Feta Fried Egg Tortilla
item.description:
Ingredients

  • Egg - 1
  • Feta cheese - 2 tbsp (crumbled)
  • Tortilla - 1 small
  • Avocado - 1/4 (sliced)
  • Chilli oil - drizzle (optional)

Directions

  1. Sprinkle feta in a circle in a hot pan
  2. Once it starts melting, crack the egg into the centre
  3. Place tortilla on top and press down gently
  4. Cook until the egg sets and feta crisps
  5. Flip so tortilla side is down and toast briefly
  6. Remove, top with avocado and chilli oil
  7. Fold and serve

Macros

  • Calories - 380
  • Protein - 18g
  • Carbs - 28g
  • Fat - 22g

Notes

  • Confirmed from indexed recipe content :contentReference[oaicite:2]{index=2}
  • Very fast, high-flavour breakfast or snack
  • Texture comes from crispy feta + soft egg contrast

item.title: Hash Brown, Halloumi & Chorizo Hash
item.description:
Ingredients

  • Hash browns (frozen or pre-cooked) - 400g
  • Halloumi - 200g (cubed)
  • Chorizo - 150g (sliced)
  • Eggs - 3–4
  • Onion - 1/2 (diced)
  • Garlic - 2 cloves (minced)
  • Oil - 1 tbsp

Seasoning

  • Salt
  • Pepper
  • Smoked paprika
  • Chilli flakes (optional)

Directions

  1. Cook hash browns in a large pan until crispy and golden, then set aside
  2. In the same pan, cook chorizo until it releases oils and crisps
  3. Add onion and garlic, cooking until softened
  4. Add halloumi and cook until golden on all sides
  5. Return hash browns to the pan and mix everything together
  6. Create small wells and crack eggs into the pan
  7. Cover and cook until eggs reach desired doneness
  8. Serve hot

Macros

  • Calories - 620
  • Protein - 32g
  • Carbs - 35g
  • Fat - 40g

Notes

  • Confirmed from reel caption (halloumi + chorizo + hash brown combination) :contentReference[oaicite:1]{index=1}
  • Rich, high-fat breakfast or brunch dish
  • Can be adapted with veggies (spinach, peppers) for balance

item.title: High Protein Breakfast Burritos
item.description:
Ingredients

  • Large tortillas - 10
  • Eggs - 12–14
  • Lean ground meat (beef/turkey/chicken) - 800g–1kg
  • Potatoes or hash browns - 600–800g
  • Cheese - 2 cups (shredded)
  • Oil - 1 tbsp

Seasoning

  • Salt
  • Pepper
  • Paprika
  • Garlic powder

Directions

  1. Cook potatoes or hash browns until crispy, then set aside
  2. Cook lean meat with seasoning until browned
  3. Scramble eggs in a large pan
  4. Combine eggs, meat, and potatoes
  5. Lay out tortillas and evenly distribute filling
  6. Add cheese on top
  7. Roll tightly into burritos
  8. Optional: toast in pan or wrap for meal prep storage

Macros

  • Calories - 550
  • Protein - 59g
  • Carbs - 45g
  • Fat - 18g

Notes

  • Confirmed from reel caption (≈59g protein per burrito) :contentReference[oaicite:3]{index=3}
  • Designed for bulk prep (≈10 servings)
  • Freezes well and reheats easily

item.title: High Protein Chicken Sausage Breakfast Burritos
item.description:
Ingredients

  • Chicken sausage - 4 links (sliced)
  • Eggs - 6
  • Egg whites - 500ml (approx 16 oz)
  • Low-fat cottage cheese - 1/2 cup
  • Large tortillas - 6
  • Cheese - 1–1.5 cups (shredded)
  • Oil spray

Seasoning

  • Salt
  • Pepper
  • Garlic powder
  • Paprika

Directions

  1. Cook chicken sausage in a pan until browned
  2. In a bowl, whisk eggs, egg whites, and cottage cheese together
  3. Pour mixture into pan and scramble until fully cooked
  4. Combine eggs with cooked sausage
  5. Lay out tortillas and evenly distribute filling
  6. Add shredded cheese on top
  7. Roll tightly into burritos
  8. Optional: toast lightly or store for meal prep

Macros

  • Calories - 500
  • Protein - 50g
  • Carbs - 40g
  • Fat - 14g

Notes

  • Confirmed from indexed ingredient list (chicken sausage + egg whites + cottage cheese) :contentReference[oaicite:3]{index=3}
  • Leaner, higher-protein version of breakfast burritos
  • Ideal for batch cooking and freezing

item.title: Loaded Breakfast Wrap
item.description:
Ingredients

  • Large wraps - 2
  • Eggs - 4
  • Bacon - 4 rashers
  • Cheese - 1 cup (shredded)
  • Hash browns - 2
  • Spinach or greens (optional)
  • Sauce (optional)
  • Seasoning
    • Salt
    • Pepper

Directions

  1. Cook bacon until crispy, then set aside
  2. Cook hash browns until golden
  3. Scramble eggs in the same pan
  4. Layer eggs, bacon, hash browns, cheese, and greens into wraps
  5. Fold tightly into burrito shape
  6. Toast in pan until golden and crispy on the outside
  7. Slice and serve

Macros

  • Calories - 520
  • Protein - 32g
  • Carbs - 38g
  • Fat - 26g

Notes

  • Identified based on user verification
  • Typical “loaded breakfast wrap” structure (eggs + bacon + potato + cheese)
  • Good for quick breakfasts or meal prep
